title: rpl/dodag: zero/negative min_hop_rank_increase corrupts rank
description: In dodag.py line 113, min_hop_rank_increase has no validation in __post_init__. If set to zero, path_cost returns parent.rank unchanged, breaking DODAG hierarchy (child has same rank as parent). If negative, path_cost produces negative costs, which propagate to self.rank at line 260, corrupting RPL routing semantics. Fix: add validation in DodagState.__post_init__ that min_hop_rank_increase > 0.
close_reason: DodagState.__post_init__ now raises ValueError if min_hop_rank_increase <= 0. max_rank_increase and parent_switch_threshold left unchanged (not crash-class). Files: python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py, python/tests/rpl/test_dodag.py. Verified: uv run pytest tests/rpl/test_dodag.py tests/rpl/test_dao.py — passed.
